# TPC-Havoc Q5_v3

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  n.n_name,
  SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (
    1 - l.l_discount
  )) AS revenue
FROM region AS r
INNER JOIN nation AS n
  ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey
INNER JOIN supplier AS s
  ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
INNER JOIN customer AS c
  ON s.s_nationkey = c.c_nationkey
INNER JOIN orders AS o
  ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
INNER JOIN lineitem AS l
  ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey AND s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
WHERE
  r.r_name = 'ASIA'
  AND o.o_orderdate >= CAST('1994-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND o.o_orderdate < CAST('1994-01-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '1 YEAR'
GROUP BY
  n.n_name
ORDER BY
  revenue DESC
```
